name: jarvis
description: /jarvis speaks a briefing of the last answer: gist, what to do next, which decisions are open. Never speaks on its own; typing stops it.

model.title: Briefing model
model.description: Model alias or id that turns the last answer into the spoken briefing.

provider.title: Voice
provider.description: elevenlabs speaks with ElevenLabs and falls back to the system voice on failure; system always uses the system voice (cannot be interrupted).

elevenModel.title: ElevenLabs model
elevenModel.description: ElevenLabs model id, e.g. eleven_flash_v2_5 (fast, half price) or eleven_v4.

elevenVoiceDe.title: ElevenLabs voice (German)
elevenVoiceDe.description: Voice id for German briefings. Default: Jonas – dry and factual.

elevenVoiceEn.title: ElevenLabs voice (English)
elevenVoiceEn.description: Voice id for English briefings. Default: David – Deep and Engaging Storyteller (British).

apiKeyPassEntry.title: API key in pass
apiKeyPassEntry.description: pass entry holding the ElevenLabs API key (first line). ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in the environment wins.

systemVoiceDe.title: System voice (German)
systemVoiceDe.description: macOS voice for German fallback briefings (say -v '?' lists them).

systemVoiceEn.title: System voice (English)
systemVoiceEn.description: macOS voice for English fallback briefings.
